INSERT INTO collection_definitions (
                id,
                stable_key,
                external_key,
                title,
                description,
                kind,
                source,
                owner_type,
                owner_user_id,
                owner_device_id,
                owner_display_name,
                scope,
                library_id,
                visibility,
                presentation,
                media_scope,
                duplicate_policy,
                artwork,
                theme,
                provenance,
                contract_version,
                revision,
                etag
            ) VALUES (
                $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::varchar, $7::varchar,
                $8::varchar, $9, $10, $11, $12::varchar, $13,
                $14::varchar, $15::varchar, $16, $17::varchar,
                $18, $19, $20, $21, $22, $23
            )
